summary: Independent review of the doctorwatson-utxo tracker-visibility delta packet (MANIFEST.json and all 6 listed files) approves the narrow post-intake reporting-visibility correction. After the prior intake review (INTAKE-APPROVED-PAYLOAD.json) approved the 17 operational GitHub work items, root observation (INTAKE-VISIBILITY-CORRECTION.json) found that check.py --next --json surfaced 16 of 17 unique GitHub items because tracking issue GH-I89 (#89) had an empty cardanoCandidateRelevance list and was not linked from any canonical requirement row's nextAction.githubItems. Inspection of TRACKER-VISIBILITY-DELTA.json confirms that beforeRow and afterRow for EU-CON-017 (canonical SHA-256 0eff20f0b05f4c3e63665f19ca2a9d46059f7f7b389981b078991c6ee9f56530 -> 225d48fd416be2910adc93e227f860dd84f52a3ffb1a9664337e1c4c19af645a, with exactOnlyCanonicalChangeVerified: true) are byte-for-byte identical across all fields—key, id, group, source, heading, scenarioNames, applicability, implementation, validation, acceptance, scenarioRecords, sourcePins, dependsOn, nextAction.{consumer,expected,owner,blockedBy,readiness}, assessmentRef, gaps, and readLimits—except for appending a single GH-I89 entry under EU-CON-017.nextAction.githubItems explicitly marked 'tracker visibility only; not product requirement equivalence or acceptance'. Inspection of docs/utxo/doctorwatson/github/work-items.json confirms GH-I89 retains cardanoCandidateRelevance: [], open acceptance, all 13 child issues (#76-#88) separately mapped and open, wholeGoalClosed: false, nativeAuthority: 0, unchanged original requirement counts (119 / 11 / 18 = 148), and mergeAuthorizedByThisRecord: false on GH-PR74 and GH-PR75, adding only reportingVisibility pointing to EU-CON-017 as a tracker-only reference. Inspection of models/utxo/qa/check.py (lines 200-220, 296, 385-388) confirms nextAction validates only required string/array fields and carries extra fields such as githubItems as inert data into requirements and nextActions without executing commands or dispatching tasks. Post-fix observation evidence/utxo/doctorwatson-utxo-bootstrap-2026-10-17/post-intake-result.json records exitCode 0, schemaValid: true, canonicalSha256 225d48fd416be2910adc93e227f860dd84f52a3ffb1a9664337e1c4c19af645a, 148 requirements, 20 families, 17 uniqueGitHubItems, nextReadyRequirement EUC-012, and originalAcceptanceAllOpen: true. No PR #74 or PR #75 security or merge approval is transferred.
limitations: Packet-only review of /home/charl/moriarty-c2-opus55-restored-20261017/doctorwatson-utxo-tracker-visibility-review-20261017-a1-packet; no outside repository paths were read and no SDK, compiler, test suite, proof, VM, wallet, node, or network operations were executed.

Whole-canonical normalization equality outside the EU-CON-017 row and the post-fix check.py run (exitCode 0, canonicalSha256 225d48fd416be2910adc93e227f860dd84f52a3ffb1a9664337e1c4c19af645a, stdoutSha256 f8b0d8d3165d66ef699588365502f5d0749e8a5cb4b51a02c22a7c2b1da3aaec) are reviewed from the supplied TRACKER-VISIBILITY-DELTA.json, INTAKE-VISIBILITY-CORRECTION.json, and post-intake-result.json records together with models/utxo/qa/check.py source inspection.
